Name: RRRR'sPortraiture
Author: alger0210
Description:
[color=#980000][size=5]只是一个挂画，没有任何实际用途，只能用来放在墙上看
It's just a hanging picture, it has no practical use, it can only be put on the wall to look at
[/size][/color]
这个挂画是根据RRRR的主页画创作的
This hanging picture is based on the RRRR's homepage picture

已向RRRR原作者取得发布许可
Permission to publish has been obtained from the original RRRR author

它是一个和配偶肖像画完全一样大小的挂画，具体如何获得我也不太清楚，可以通过CJB提取拿到，我是那么拿到的
It's a hanging painting of exactly the same size as the portrait of the spouse, I'm not sure exactly how to get it, it can be extracted by the CJBItemSpawner, how did I get it

默认你是金发，我尽量添加了其他头发颜色可选项，下载后请在文件夹内阅读替换说明
By default you are blonde, I have added other hair color options as much as possible, please read the replacement instructions in the folder after downloading

画这副挂画只是因为我非常喜欢RRRR，并且一开始不知道RRRR自带配偶肖像画，所以尝试自己画，后来发现RRRR自带配偶肖像画，于是改成了添加的挂画家具
I painted this hanging picture just because I like RRRR very much, and at first I did not know that RRRR came with a portrait of my spouse, so I tried to paint it by myself. Later, I found that RRRR came with a portrait of my spouse, so I changed to the added hanging furniture
